assets.name: itemFrame
promptLines: Use case: stylized-concept. Hand-painted World of Warcraft game UI element in exactly the style of the
four attached references (Ascension class resource HUDs): chunky readable silhouette, broad painted
facets, soft light from upper left, dark outline, restrained detail readable at 50px. Theme Scarlet
Crusade: aged warm gold, crimson enamel, white marble, gold and orange holy fire; motif stylised
flame-rayed sun. No green, purple, blue, text, filigree, tiny scratches or photorealism. References are
style only, do not copy their subjects. A square ornamental ITEM FRAME: chunky gold bars with crimson
enamel inlay, rounded inner corners, four small flame-rayed sun corner ornaments, larger flame-rayed sun
on crimson disc at top centre, small white marble cabochon bottom centre. Empty transparent square central
opening exactly about 64% of canvas width. Bilaterally symmetric. Whole frame fully visible with 5%
margin, square front view, no perspective. 512x512 target. Genuine transparent background, including
central hole.

assets.name: itemFrameGlow
promptLines: Edit target: attached item frame. Keep EXACT canvas and registration. Replace all physical gold, enamel
and marble of frame with pure black, remove frame entirely. Only soft gold and orange holy fire licking
around its OUTSIDE silhouette, small flames above top crest. Transparent central opening becomes pure
black too. Light only on pure #000000 black background. No visible frame, gold bars, discs, corners or
other material. Bilaterally symmetric, soft broad glow rather than solid lines.
